notes:
Vynfera cuts multicolor designs: one layer per vinyl, lined up for pressing.

- **Foil layers** in Vynfera. **Split by color** makes one layer per color with the closest common vinyl – the
  outer color (outline, base) at the bottom, anti-aliased edges between colors ignored. Or add layers yourself
  and move parts into them with the new **Assign** tool (L): click a part or drag a frame.
- Upper layers are cut 1 mm smaller where they meet the layers below (gap per layer, 0 = edge to edge; a negative
  gap makes an overlap). The eye next to a layer hides it from the view and the export.
- **On garment** and **For cutting** show each vinyl in its own color and finish.
- Export: one SVG/DXF/PDF with a layer per vinyl (Silhouette Studio and others see the layers), and optionally
  one file per layer on the same page and weeding frame, so the cuts line up.
- An image without transparency (JPG, white background) – opened directly in Vynfera or sent from Preparation –
  has its background color removed and keeps its other colors. Before, only the dark parts were cut when opened
  directly, and the whole rectangle when sent from Preparation.
- **Original** shows the design in its own colors on a checkerboard; a new design opens in **For cutting**;
  **Split by color** is highlighted when the design has more than one color.
- Exported files end with the module that made them: `_applika.png` (Preparation; the old default `_dtf` is
  switched over), `_vynfera.svg/.dxf/.pdf`, `_01_gangsheet.png`.
- Trim ignores nearly invisible pixels (alpha up to 3 %) left from soft edges, so it no longer keeps extra empty
  space around the design. The Trim margin setting (2 mm by default) still applies.
- Fixed: a tooltip could stay on screen after clicking a button that rebuilt the panel.
- Fixed: two exports in a row in Vynfera could skip the first one.
